# Farm provenance
Upstream: https://github.com/Gmast2662/grow-your-garden (MIT).
The original garden core and license are retained here. The grid, growth-stage presentation and soil/plant composition adapt the earlier GardenGame-based demo. Its SVG crop drawings are reused from that demo, not attributed to upstream.
Client money, local saves and game reward functions are not used for real assets. Planting, timers, stealing, grants and balances are enforced by the Go rewards module and PostgreSQL transactions.
